usedFor: Shopify holds your orders and checkouts, and Zulip delivers alerts into a stream through “Send Stream Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send Stream Message” in Zulip
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order posts to a chosen stream and topic, so the whole team sees it in one thread.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so a post to Zulip follows a scheduled check.
